In Android settings, open VPN, tap the ⚙ next to Mindveto and switch on \"Always-on VPN\". Then it starts by itself after a restart. For children, also use Google Family Link so they cannot change settings.

Mindveto blocks AI services in every app on this phone by answering their address lookups with \"does not exist\". It cannot block AI built into apps you allow, AI that runs fully on the phone, or apps that use their own secure DNS. Android lets the phone owner switch any VPN off in Settings.

Warning: \"Private DNS\" is set to a custom provider in Android settings. That can bypass the block. Set it to Off or Automatic (Settings > Network > Private DNS).
Some gadgets can sense movement through walls using Wi-Fi, or hide a camera or tracker. Many run on small ESP chips. This check looks for such chips nearby. Everything stays on this phone.
Turn Wi-Fi on first, then try again.
The check needs permission to see nearby Wi-Fi devices. Nothing is sent anywhere.
No Wi-Fi radios found. On older Android, turn on Location (it is needed to see Wi-Fi) and try again.
Checked %1$d Wi-Fi radios. No small sensor boards found nearby. 👍
Checked %2$d Wi-Fi radios. %1$d look like small ESP boards:

Many of these are normal smart plugs, lamps or doorbells. Do you not know a device that is \"very close\"? Walk around with this check, look for small boxes with a USB cable, and ask your landlord or housemates. Change your Wi-Fi password if you are unsure.

Get a notification when an app starts using your camera or microphone while Mindveto is on (for example an app that secretly listens or records for AI). Android does not say which app; check the green dot at the top of the screen. Nothing is stored or sent.
Warn me when the camera or microphone turns on
📷 Your camera is being used right now. Was that you? If not, check which apps have camera access in Settings > Privacy.
🎤 Your microphone is being used right now. Was that you? If not, check which apps have microphone access in Settings > Privacy.
What happened on this phone: wrong PINs, and when the protection was switched off. Kept only on this phone.
AI blocking was switched off in Android settings or by another VPN app. If that was not you, open Mindveto and switch it on again.
AI blocking was on, but it is not running any more (for example after the app was force-stopped). Tap the button to switch it on again.
